---
title: "Education Equality in India"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: darkly
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(flexdashboard)
library(scales)

# Find the processed-data folder whether this Rmd is in the project root
# or inside a subfolder such as reports/.
data_dir_candidates <- c(
  file.path("data", "processed"),
  file.path("..", "data", "processed")
)

data_dir <- data_dir_candidates[
  vapply(data_dir_candidates, function(x) dir.exists(x), logical(1))
][1]

if (is.na(data_dir)) {
  stop(
    "Cannot find data/processed. Keep this Rmd in the project root ",
    "or one folder below it, and check the project folder structure."
  )
}

literacy_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "cleaned_literacy_2011.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

enrolment_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "cleaned_2021_22.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

infrastructure_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "infrastructure_analysis_2023_24.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Standardize column names for use throughout the dashboard.
literacy_data <- literacy_raw %>%
  filter(toupper(trimws(State)) != "INDIA") %>%
  transmute(
    State = State,
    Male = as.numeric(`Male - All`),
    Female = as.numeric(`Female - All`),
    Total = as.numeric(`Persons - All`),
    Gender_Gap = Male - Female
  )

boys_col <- grep(
  "Enrolment of Age Group.*Boys$",
  names(enrolment_raw),
  value = TRUE
)[1]

girls_col <- grep(
  "Enrolment of Age Group.*Girls$",
  names(enrolment_raw),
  value = TRUE
)[1]

total_col <- grep(
  "Enrolment of Age Group.*Total$",
  names(enrolment_raw),
  value = TRUE
)[1]

if (any(is.na(c(boys_col, girls_col, total_col)))) {
  stop("Expected Boys, Girls and Total enrolment columns were not found.")
}

enrolment_data <- enrolment_raw %>%
  filter(toupper(trimws(State)) != "INDIA") %>%
  transmute(
    State = State,
    Boys = as.numeric(.data[[boys_col]]),
    Girls = as.numeric(.data[[girls_col]]),
    Total = as.numeric(.data[[total_col]])
  )

infrastructure_data <- infrastructure_raw %>%
  filter(toupper(trimws(State)) != "INDIA") %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        Total_Schools, Total_Enrolments, Total_Teachers, PTR,
        Avg_Teachers, Avg_Enrolments, Zero_Enrolment_Schools,
        Single_Teacher_Schools, Zero_Enrolment_Percentage,
        Single_Teacher_Percentage
      ),
      as.numeric
    )
  )

# A single selection controls the relevant charts across the dashboard.
state_choices <- sort(unique(infrastructure_data$State))
```

# Overview

```{r}
selectInput(
  "selected_state",
  "Select State / UT",
  choices = c("All States / UTs", state_choices),
  selected = "All States / UTs",
  width = "100%"
)
```

```{r}
selected_rows <- reactive({
  req(input$selected_state)

  if (input$selected_state == "All States / UTs") {
    return(list(
      literacy = literacy_data,
      enrolment = enrolment_data,
      infrastructure = infrastructure_data
    ))
  }

  list(
    literacy = filter(literacy_data, State == input$selected_state),
    enrolment = filter(enrolment_data, State == input$selected_state),
    infrastructure = filter(infrastructure_data, State == input$selected_state)
  )
})
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### States and UTs

```{r}
valueBox(

)
```

```{r}
)
```

### Total Students

```{r}
valueBox(

)
```

### Total Teachers

```{r}
valueBox(

```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Boys and Girls Enrolment

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- selected_rows()$enrolment %>%
    summarise(
      Boys = sum(Boys, na.rm = TRUE),
      Girls = sum(Girls, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Gender", values_to = "Students")

  plot_ly(
    d, labels = ~Gender, values = ~Students,
    type = "pie", hole = 0.58,
    textinfo = "label+percent",
    marker = list(colors = c("#22d3ee", "#f472b6"))
  ) %>%
    layout(
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = "white"),
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
})
```

### Literacy Gender Comparison

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- selected_rows()$literacy %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Male, Female),
      names_to = "Gender",
      values_to = "Literacy"
    )

  plot_ly(
    d, x = ~State, y = ~Literacy,
    color = ~Gender, type = "bar",
    colors = c(Male = "#22d3ee", Female = "#f472b6")
  ) %>%
    layout(
      barmode = "group",
      yaxis = list(title = "Literacy (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
      xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -35),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = "white")
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
})
```

# Literacy Analysis

Row
-------------------------------------

### Male vs Female Literacy by State

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- selected_rows()$literacy

  plot_ly(d, x = ~Male, y = ~Female, text = ~State,
          type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
          marker = list(size = 10, color = "#22d3ee"),
          hovertemplate = paste(
            "<b>%{text}</b><br>Male: %{x:.1f}%<br>",
            "Female: %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>"
          )) %>%
    add_trace(
      x = c(0, 100), y = c(0, 100),
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
      line = list(dash = "dash", color = "#f472b6"),
      name = "Equal literacy reference"
    ) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "Male literacy (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
      yaxis = list(title = "Female literacy (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = "white")
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
})
```

### Literacy Gender Gap

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- selected_rows()$literacy %>%
    arrange(desc(Gender_Gap))

  plot_ly(
    d, x = ~reorder(State, Gender_Gap), y = ~Gender_Gap,
    type = "bar", marker = list(color = "#f59e0b")
  ) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -40),
      yaxis = list(title = "Male minus female literacy (percentage points)"),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = "white")
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
})
```

### Literacy Data Table

```{r}
renderDT({
  datatable(
    selected_rows()$literacy,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
})
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Male and Female Literacy

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- selected_rows()$literacy %>%
    select(State, Male, Female) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Male, Female),
      names_to = "Gender",
      values_to = "Literacy"
    )

  plot_ly(
    d, x = ~State, y = ~Literacy,
    color = ~Gender, type = "bar",
    colors = c(Male = "#22d3ee", Female = "#f472b6")
  ) %>%
    layout(
      barmode = "group",
      xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -40),
      yaxis = list(title = "Literacy (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = "white")
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
})
```

### Girls' Share of Enrolment

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  d <- selected_rows()$enrolment %>%
    mutate(Girls_Share = if_else(
      Total > 0, Girls / Total * 100, NA_real_
    )) %>%
    arrange(desc(Girls_Share))

  plot_ly(
    d, x = ~reorder(State, Girls_Share), y = ~Girls_Share,
    type = "bar", marker = list(color = "#f472b6")
  ) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -40),
      yaxis = list(title = "Girls' share (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = "white")
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE)
})
```

# Data Explorer

Row
-------------------------------------

### Choose a Dataset

```{r}
selectInput(
  "explorer_dataset",
  "Select dataset",
  choices = c(
    "Literacy (Census 2011)",
    "Enrolment (UDISE 2021-22)",
    "Infrastructure (UDISE 2023-24)"
  )
)
```

### Browse Data

```{r}
renderDT({
  chosen <- switch(
    input$explorer_dataset,
    "Literacy (Census 2011)" = literacy_data,
    "Enrolment (UDISE 2021-22)" = enrolment_data,
    "Infrastructure (UDISE 2023-24)" = infrastructure_data
  )

  datatable(
    chosen,
    filter = "top",
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
})
```
